title: fedi-e2ee missing zeroize on key intermediates
description: ed25519_to_x25519_private() at fedi-e2ee/src/lib.rs:186-192 does not zeroize two intermediates containing key material: (1) the SHA-512 hash output (GenericArray<u8, U64>) which contains the full Ed25519 expanded key, and (2) the x_bytes [u8; 32] array copied from hash[..32]. Both remain on the stack after X25519Secret::from() consumes the value. The shared_secret and encryption_key ARE zeroized in encrypt_dm/decrypt_dm, but the X25519 private key derivation path leaks intermediates. Fix: make hash and x_bytes mutable, zeroize both after use.
close_reason: Fixed: ed25519_to_x25519_private now zeroizes SHA-512 hash and x_bytes intermediates
